QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_14

question.text: An open-ended Cat III fund's HWM NAV/unit is INR 1,420. Current NAV/unit is INR 1,278. What is the current drawdown from HWM?

explanation.text: The Logic: Drawdown % = (Current − HWM)/HWM = (1278 − 1420)/1420 = −142/1420 = −10.00%. The fund must gain +11.11% from here to reclaim HWM (crystallisation point). The Trap: -11.11% is the REQUIRED gain from trough to HWM, not current drawdown. -14.20% uses wrong divisor. -9.00% is a rounding artefact. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B Cat III Distributor tests drawdown conceptually; XIX-E tests computation. Manager's Pro-Tip: Asymmetry: a -50% drawdown needs +100% to recover. Communicate the required-recovery number to LPs during drawdowns — it reframes the hurdle to reclaim carry.
